evidence.quote: 7 Semester : 210 ECTS 7 Semester : Regular programme duration: 3.5 years.
Language : English Language : The language of instruction is English, and applicants are required to submit proof of English language proficiency with their application.
Newly enrolled international students not from EU/EEA countries have to pay tuition fees of 1,500 € per semester.

For applicants without a German university entrance qualification, the first step in applying to the BA International Business is to have your certificates recognised by the Studienkolleg – Center for International Students or uni-assist.

note.fr: L'admission est sélective : la décision se base principalement sur la note globale du diplôme d'accès aux études supérieures ; d'autres critères peuvent améliorer vos chances.
note.en: Admission is selective: decisions are based primarily on the overall grade of your higher education entrance qualification; other criteria can improve your chances.

evidence.quote: Admission decisions are based primarily on the overall grade of the applicant's higher education entrance qualification.

notes: The programme page (hs-heilbronn.de/en/international-business) says "Tuition fee : 0 €", but the university-wide tuition-fees page states 1,500 € per semester for newly enrolled international students not from EU/EEA countries, so the fee fact follows that page. There is no dedicated programme page for a foreign-diploma applicant; document recognition via Studienkolleg Konstanz or uni-assist is stated on the DAAD page and on the Bachelor application page, while the detailed application-document list is given for IB-E international applicants. The requirement deadline is only given as "July 15th" without a year, hence recorded as a recurring deadline; no month/day/year deadline with a year was found.
